scenarios.title: Escape casts a card from the graveyard if its cost, including exiled cards, can be paid
decisions: A considers casting Phoenix of Ash from the graveyard for its escape cost {2}{R}{R} and exiling three other cards from the graveyard.

variants.label: enough_cards
variants.expected: Casting Phoenix of Ash from A's graveyard for its escape cost is legal.

variants.label: too_few_cards
variants.delta: A's graveyard holds only two other cards besides Phoenix of Ash.
variants.expected: Casting Phoenix of Ash from A's graveyard is not legal: three other cards cannot be exiled.

variants.label: too_little_mana
variants.delta: A controls three Mountains instead of four.
variants.expected: Casting Phoenix of Ash from A's graveyard is not legal: {2}{R}{R} cannot be paid.

scenarios.title: A permanent that escaped enters with counters and its linked enters-this-way trigger fires, even with no counters added
decisions: A casts Pharika's Spawn from the graveyard for its escape cost {5}{B}, tapping six Swamps and exiling three other cards from the graveyard.
Both players pass; Pharika's Spawn resolves and the enters-this-way trigger resolves.

variants.label: escaped
variants.expected: Pharika's Spawn enters with two +1/+1 counters as a 5/6, and its enters-this-way trigger fires: B sacrifices Grizzly Bears, which goes to B's graveyard.

variants.label: hard_cast
variants.delta: Pharika's Spawn starts in A's hand instead of the graveyard and is cast for its mana cost {3}{B}.
variants.expected: Pharika's Spawn enters as a 3/4 with no counters; it did not escape, so no enters-this-way trigger fires and B keeps Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: no_counters_added
variants.expected: Pharika's Spawn enters as a 3/4 with no counters, but the enters-this-way trigger still fires: B sacrifices Grizzly Bears.

scenarios.forge_notes: The Solemnity variant relies on Forge running the ImmediateTrigger sub-ability after a prevented PutCounter; if it does not, Forge deviates from rule 702.138c.

scenarios.title: A permanent that escaped has the ability it escapes with
decisions: A casts Skyway Robber from the graveyard for its escape cost {3}{U}, tapping four Islands and exiling five other cards from the graveyard.
Both players pass; Skyway Robber resolves.

variants.label: escaped
variants.expected: Skyway Robber (3/3 flying) is on the battlefield with the escape-granted triggered ability: whenever it deals combat damage to a player, A may cast an artifact, instant or sorcery card exiled with it without paying its mana cost.

variants.label: hard_cast
variants.delta: Skyway Robber starts in A's hand instead of the graveyard and is cast for its mana cost {3}{U}.
variants.expected: Skyway Robber (3/3 flying) is on the battlefield without the combat-damage triggered ability, because it did not escape.
